title: Deliver Livestock to Dunfingfield Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Livestock** delivered to **Dunfingfield Food Processing Plant** (industry id 6, near tile 112,77).

A likely supplier is **Denfingway-on-sea Farm** (industry id 4, near tile 115,49); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **370 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
